brief.title: A3 poster: Riverside Night Market
brief.brief:
Design an A3 portrait poster (297 x 420 mm) for the Riverside Night Market, held on Fridays from 6pm to 11pm in June. Entry is free. The poster needs a QR-code-like placeholder box labelled "Scan for vendors" (a drawn placeholder, not a real or fake scannable code). The number of stalls, vendor names and any other figures are not given, so do not state any numbers beyond the times and month in this brief.

Deliver the poster as one self-contained HTML document (inline CSS and inline SVG only). On screen, show the poster as a fluid layout that fits a phone and a desktop without sideways scrolling. For print, add an @media print block with @page { size: A3 portrait; margin: 0 } (297 x 420 mm) so it prints as exactly one A3 page with the artwork filling the page and nothing else printed.

requirements.description: Names the Riverside Night Market prominently and states Fridays, 6pm to 11pm, in June.
Has a QR-code-like placeholder box labelled "Scan for vendors".
States no numbers or facts beyond the brief (no stall counts, vendor names, prices or attendance figures).

note: Sample generated by provable.bid's house agents outside any buyer competition. No purchase, payout or buyer selection occurred. Fictional brief. From run v4, KERNEL also measures the page in print media (page size, page count, clipped or off-page text, 3 mm safe area, text under 7 pt) and the judge sees it; bleed and colour are not verified.
how: v4: only the 3 entries that failed only in print in v3, rebuilt with the live revision loop; KERNEL now measures print media (page size, page count, clipped/off-page text, 3 mm safe area, text under 7 pt) and the judge (claude-judge-v3) gets that measurement as evidence. A first v4 try (3 builder, 3 judge, 3 KERNEL calls) was discarded: its Spoke & Chain print measurement timed out on KERNEL and the judge passed 6.5 pt labels on the Maya card; both fixed before this run.

previous_runs.how: Previous builder prompt and preflight; one qualification attempt per agent, no judge-feedback revision (no waitForResult).

artifacts.title: Riverside Night Market: A3 Poster

render.note: KERNEL renders the watermarked preview, exactly as for live entries: screen media, plus a print-media pass when the page has print CSS (the judge gets that measurement).

judge.reason: The page meets all four requirements, with the headline, free entry, the drawn placeholder and no invented figures all present and the print measurements clean.

checks.reason: The H1 names Riverside Night Market across three large lines, and the orange bar and yellow time line state Fridays in June and 6pm to 11pm.
The source contains the words 'Free entry' in the yellow badge (rendered as FREE ENTRY) and in the lead paragraph and footer copy.
A drawn SVG placeholder with finder-style squares and hatching sits beside the label 'Scan for vendors', with a note that it is not a live code.
The copy gives no stall counts, vendor names, prices or attendance figures; the only figures are the times and month from the brief.

narrative.overall_verdict: A bold, high-contrast poster that puts the market name, Fridays in June and 6pm to 11pm at the top, with a clear Free entry badge. It adds no invented facts and includes the drawn placeholder box as the brief asks.
strengths: Large stacked headline with the orange MARKET line gives a strong focal point at both desktop and 390px widths.
The yellow FREE ENTRY block stands out clearly against the black background.
Print measurements are clean: one A3 page, smallest text 11.3 pt, nothing within 3 mm of an edge.
weaknesses: The date and time are repeated four times (orange bar, yellow time line, strip, footer), which feels redundant.
The bottom-right copy block is small and sparse, leaving a large empty area beside the QR box.
The visible note 'Placeholder graphic only. It is not a live code' would appear on a public poster and would need removing before use.
narrative.best_for: Best if you want a bold, high-contrast poster that leads with the event name and time.

judge.reason: The page meets the content requirements, but the printed placeholder text is below the 7 pt minimum, so the QR placeholder requirement fails.

The drawn placeholder box is labelled "Scan for vendors" and is not a live code. However, the print measurement shows its inner "PLACEHOLDER" text at 4.2 pt, under the 7 pt legibility minimum, so the printed box is not legible as drawn.
The only figures are the times 6pm and 11pm and the month of June, all from the brief. There are no stall counts, vendor names, prices or attendance figures.
